name: The Scatter
premise: The band breaks at your roar and runners peel off along every open line.
loop: For a few strides you are faster than they are. Each runner flees along a visible line toward the dark; you cut lines by moving through them. You cannot reach every line — every step toward one runner opens another's escape.
signals: Escape routes read as the runners' own paths and the gaps between rocks; a runner you head off stops dead and cowers; an escaped runner shrinks into the dark still carrying the story.
outcome_win: Everyone you head off turns shallowly to your color, trembling.
outcome_fail: The ones who escape spread the tale of you outward to camps you have never seen.
why_fun: Chase geometry as instant triage — commitment costs are visible the moment you move, and you cannot catch everyone by design.
gdd_quote: you have a handful of strides to cut off the runners
